name: OWASP_A01_IDOR_Object_Enumeration
search: index=web_logs sourcetype="access_combined" | rex field=uri_path "\/(?[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)\/(?\d+)" | where isnotnull(object_id) | stats dc(object_id) as unique_objects count by src_ip, user, endpoint | where unique_objects > 40 AND count > 60
description: Detects rapid enumeration of numerical object identifiers (IDOR).
